Use only when an authoritative governing equation can support a later non-circular term-balance derivation.
Use for hidden natural constants, normalized coordinates, or an unselected unit convention; no constant value is supplied here.
Use only after both participating pillars have independently reviewed internal unit systems.
Use only when a source-backed physical scale must be measured and cannot be obtained from a convention or derivation.
Use when the physical object must be defined more precisely before a unit question is meaningful.
Use when present evidence cannot authorize a derivation, calibration, conversion map, or rejection.
Use only after reviewed dimensional evidence proves that the bridge is incompatible in its present form.
